query: SELECT DISTINCT target_service_id AS "target_service_id!: String",target_endpoint_id AS "target_endpoint_id!: String",target_session_id AS "target_session_id!: String" FROM router_pushes WHERE retention='creationAge' AND kind IN (?,?) AND delivery_state IN ('pending','held') ORDER BY target_service_id,target_endpoint_id,target_session_id
